##: What a workbench release is built from, besides this repository at the release tag.
Read by .github/workflows/release-workbench.yml. Each sibling is checked out at `commit`; the
Odin compiler is laytan/setup-odin's `release` (a monthly tag, so a build can be repeated).
Re-pin with `just sims pin-deps` from clean, pushed checkouts - it refuses dirty or unpushed ones,
because CI can only check out what is on GitHub. bridge-markup is private: the workflow reads it
with the SIBLING_REPOS_TOKEN secret (a fine-grained token with read access to it).
